inlines.v: SOT, noun 1. A stupid person; a blockhead; a dull fellow; a dolt. 2. A person stupefied by excessive drinking; an habitual drunkard. What can ennoble sots? SOT, verb transitive To stupefy; to infatuate; to besot. I hat to see a brave bold bellow sotted. [Not much used.] [See Besot.] SOT, verb intransitive To tipple to stupidity. [Little used.]
